Dina Soliman, a Security Engineer at AdvertiseSphere Inc., is a rare blend of technical precision and operational discipline. Her work in adtech requires balancing innovation with robust security, a challenge she meets with consistent rigor.  

Dina’s technical expertise is defined by her ownership of compliance frameworks. She redesigned AdvertiseSphere’s SOC2 audit process, cutting review cycles by 35% while resolving 12 critical gaps. Her encryption architecture, which secures 80% of customer data pipelines, has withstood three third-party penetration tests. She also spearheaded IAM overhauls, reducing unauthorized access incidents by 40% through zero-trust policies. Network security is her specialty—she architected a zero-day mitigation strategy that blocked 17,000+ malicious requests monthly.  

Beyond technical mastery, Dina thrives in collaborative environments. She mentors junior engineers, often leading informal “security deep dives” to share threat modeling insights. Her ability to distill complex compliance requirements into actionable steps has streamlined cross-functional workflows.  

Dina’s impact is felt across teams. Her incident response protocols, refined after a high-profile breach, reduced downtime by 22% and minimized reputational risk. She approaches challenges with calm persistence, whether debugging a compromised system or negotiating with auditors.  

Dina Soliman is a Security Engineer who consistently elevates security as a strategic asset. Her work at AdvertiseSphere has set industry benchmarks, and I strongly recommend her for any role requiring technical excellence and operational accountability.
